name: mod-holylocal-priest
about: mods/holylocal (the Priest without the Celestial Ruins DLC, beta testers only): with it enabled the create-character class list offers the Priest, 'select priest' shows its title, and 'create' makes a Priest character that stands in town. The control is mod-holylocal-priest-control (no holylocal: no Priest in the list, since the lab's game has no DLC).
